The Chinese characters for Christian

As a transliteration, Christian is usually written 克里斯蒂安 (Kè lǐ sī dì ān). Each character is listed below with its own dictionary meaning — the name is chosen by sound, not by meaning, and Moying does not translate names. Please have a person review the characters before any permanent use such as a tattoo.

克
Kè
overcome, gram
里
lǐ
inside, a mile
斯
sī
this (transliteration)
蒂
dì
stem (of fruit)
安
ān
peace, safe

Origin and meaning

With Latin origins, Christian is usually read as “follower of Christ”.

About the name Christian

A name that literally means a follower of Christ, popular across many languages.

As a gift or a tattoo

The name Christian suits a framed gift, and the clean high-resolution file also works as a tattoo design.
